title: Threshold sign gap identity
statement: For every sign $s\\in\\{-1,1\\}$ and real number $z$, let $\\operatorname{sgn}_0(z)$ be $1$ when $z\\ge0$ and $-1$ otherwise. Then $(\\operatorname{sgn}_0(z)-s)z$ equals $2|z|$ if $s\\ne\\operatorname{sgn}_0(z)$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
